_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is engaged in the discovery, development, licensing, manufacturing, marketing, distribution and sale of pharmaceutical and nutritional products.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1); 'Our Pharmaceuticals Segment is confronted by a record level of industry patent expirations and increasingly aggressive generic competition.' (Item 1A); 'In 2008, net sales of PLAVIX* contributed $5.6 billion, representing 27% of total net sales' (Item 1A); 'It is possible that the Company may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading)

(Item 1A heading). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.39x; -18% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.52; conservative 2yr +81%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -54.1%/yr (worst year FY02-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.7%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.7%/yr (FY02-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +47.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2010-01-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.39x (75.4% downside to Bear $6 / +191.5% upside to Bull $71) | Adj composite 3.10 vs market 1.58: gap +1.52 [UNDERVALUED] | -18% above the EPP floor $30 (15x FY10E $1.99) | Conservative 2-yr case: +80.8% total (+40.4%/yr) | At 12.2x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $32 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +10.9% in Q4 2009, forward revenues +7% (no FY10 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2009 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
